title: OmniRoute
subtitle: A beginner's guide to using many AI models through one free gateway, and keeping your work going by switching models automatically when one runs out.
info: Free and open source (MIT licence). You pay only for paid providers you choose to add.
Your own computer (Windows, Mac, Linux), a server, or Docker

sections.p: Think of OmniRoute as a switchboard for AI models. It gives you one single address that all your AI tools can talk to, and decides which model answers each request.

sections.h2: Why that matters for a beginner:

bullets: One setup, many models. Connect a provider once and every tool can use it.
Automatic switching. If one model hits its limit, OmniRoute moves to the next.

sections.callout: No AI provider gives truly unlimited free use. OmniRoute stacks free tiers and switches between them automatically.
sections.title: Read this first

sections.callout: Use one account per provider unless its terms allow more.
sections.title: Stay safe
